g.text: Firebase push through a durable notification queue
persist active subscription binding in IndexedDB
Domain Outbox handler commits notification + per-device jobs atomically
claim pending job / SKIP LOCKED / 2-minute lease
mark Sent if lease still owned
check active binding / display fixed generic text
backoff / retry / dead letter after 8 attempts
clear active binding / suppress old-account delivery
Queue is durable; Firebase acceptance is not proof of display.
Crash redelivery is possible; notification tags replace visible duplicates.
No document text, company names, scores or reviewer comments go to FCM.
